findings.summary: The interrupted marker-only CURATOR handoff now converges to the existing CURATOR task and completes the missing selection receipt without creating a second owner.
findings.broken_invariant: Recovery must preserve exactly one CURATOR owner and complete durable selection evidence after interruption between source-marker and receipt writes.

evidence_refs.section: Marker-only CURATOR handoff recovery implementation and tests

hidden_assumptions: Selection recovery assumes the task backend exposes newly created CURATOR tasks and persisted source-task markers consistently to subsequent listTasks calls.
